justification.intent: Preserve exact categorical class codes during reprojection; no interpolation between discrete land-cover classes is scientifically valid

alternatives.why_not: Bilinear interpolation would create blended non-existent class codes (e.g. 45 between Tree cover=10 and Built-up=50) which are meaningless for categorical classification
Same problem as bilinear, worse; produces continuous interpolated values from discrete classes

choice.rationale: WorldCover is a categorical dataset with 11 discrete integer class codes. Nearest-neighbour resampling assigns each output pixel the value of its nearest input pixel, preserving valid class codes unchanged.
choice.tradeoffs: Creates blocky/staircase appearance at class boundaries; acceptable for categorical display
